seo.title: Contact StarOrigin | Hiring, jobs and partnerships
seo.description: Contact StarOrigin by form, phone, email or WhatsApp. Offices in Nagpur, Hyderabad, Dubai and Dallas. Answers to common questions from employers and candidates.

hero.title: Let's start
hero.lead: Hiring, job hunting or exploring a partnership? Tell us a little about what you need and the right person will get back to you.

hire.text: Have a specific role in mind? A hiring brief gets you a faster, more precise response.

job.text: Looking for openings? Browse live roles from our clients and apply directly.

successText: Thanks for reaching out. A member of our team will reply within one business day.

employers.question: Which industries do you work with?
employers.answer: Our clients span many industries, and we recruit across all functional areas.

employers.question: Do you work with startups and small companies?
employers.answer: Yes. We support new projects as well as small companies planning to expand.

employers.question: What levels do you hire for?
employers.answer: From managers up to CXO level.

employers.question: Are your searches confidential?
employers.answer: Yes. All searches and search criteria are kept confidential.

employers.question: How do you find candidates?
employers.answer: About 20% of placements come through job postings. The other 80% come from dedicated headhunting, approaching people who aren't actively applying.

employers.question: Do you only hire in the cities where you have offices?
employers.answer: No. We serve clients nationally, not just in Nagpur and Hyderabad, and internationally through our UAE and US entities. See our offices.

candidates.question: How do I apply for a role?
candidates.answer: Browse open jobs and apply to any that fit, or submit your CV and we'll match you to new openings.

candidates.question: Do I have to pay to use StarOrigin?
candidates.answer: Generally, no. Our fees are paid by the employers we recruit for, so job seekers aren't charged for our recruitment services.

candidates.question: How long do you keep my CV?
candidates.answer: How long we keep your data and how you can ask us to delete it is explained in our candidate data notice.

candidates.question: How do I update my profile or CV?
candidates.answer: Submit your latest CV through the CV form using the same email address, or write to hello@starorigin.in with your changes.

cta.title: Hiring or job hunting?
cta.text: Brief us on a role, or browse live openings from our clients.
